build_llm_messages.name: empty text block is dropped, real blocks stay
build_llm_messages.note: the trailing empty text block goes; tool_use survives

build_llm_messages.name: whitespace-only blocks omit the turn
build_llm_messages.note: a turn whose every block filters out uses the derived string instead

build_llm_messages.name: fully empty turn is dropped
build_llm_messages.note: no blocks, no content, no images: shipping it fails the whole request

build_llm_messages.name: all blocks drop and no string fallback drops the turn
build_llm_messages.note: whitespace-only block, empty content: nothing to ship

build_llm_messages.name: assistant image replays as a generate_image tool pair
build_llm_messages.note: tool_use on the assistant turn, tool_result merged into the next user turn

build_llm_messages.name: image-only assistant turn at the end flushes its own user turn
build_llm_messages.note: the shape that wedged a live conversation: nothing follows to merge into

build_llm_messages.name: owed tool_result before an assistant turn injects a user turn
build_llm_messages.note: the API wants the result in the turn right after the call, and the next emitted message is not a user turn

build_llm_messages.name: owed tool_result survives a dropped empty turn
build_llm_messages.note: the empty turn between is skipped; the result lands on the user turn after it

build_llm_messages.name: two images on one assistant turn
build_llm_messages.note: index is part of the synthetic id, and both results ride the same next turn

build_llm_messages.name: text standin folds the image into caption text
build_llm_messages.note: no tool blocks: the file is never read, so the path need not exist

build_llm_messages.name: text standin does not encode a readable image
build_llm_messages.note: the file is there and openable, and the stand-in still wins — the mode decides, not whether the encode would have succeeded

build_llm_messages.name: text standin without a caption
build_llm_messages.note: the bare stand-in string

build_llm_messages.name: text standin trims a whitespace-only caption
build_llm_messages.note: a caption of spaces is treated as absent, not rendered as one

build_llm_messages.name: unreadable image degrades to the stand-in under tool pair
build_llm_messages.note: emitting the tool_use anyway would dangle it and fail the request

build_llm_messages.name: tool pair trims the caption before it reaches the input
build_llm_messages.note: same trim as the stand-in, on the tool_use input and the result's text block

build_llm_messages.name: user images render as raw image blocks
build_llm_messages.note: only assistant turns reroute; a user attachment keeps the plain shape

build_llm_messages.name: user images precede stored blocks
build_llm_messages.note: with content_blocks present the images still go first

build_llm_messages.name: synthetic ids sanitize and truncate the file stem
build_llm_messages.note: non-alphanumerics become underscores, the stem caps at 48 characters, and a stemless path falls back to `image`

build_llm_messages.name: provenance travels with the turn
build_llm_messages.note: provider_key and model ride along so the adapter can judge replayability

build_llm_messages.name: a system role message keeps its role
build_llm_messages.note: the prompt's Role::System maps to a system wire turn, not user

build_llm_messages.name: one system block keeps its label
build_llm_messages.note: this used to serialize as a bare string and drop the label with it

build_llm_messages.name: every system block keeps its label and order
build_llm_messages.note: memory_index last is what the Anthropic breakpoint anchors around

build_llm_messages.name: thinking and tool_result blocks project onto the wire
build_llm_messages.note: a stored tool_result's string content, and thinking with and without a carrier

build_llm_messages.name: an empty prompt renders to nothing
build_llm_messages.note: no messages, no system

prepare_chat_context.name: no tools no files
prepare_chat_context.note: nothing enabled and no prompt files: tool_defs is None and the system prompt is whatever assemble_prompt makes of nothing
